## Objective
- Make the MTD quiz prototype full-screen (no modal/inner scroll), apply the original site's link and button/option-card state styles (default, hover, focus-visible, active/pressed) to shared classes only, keeping changes minimal.

## Important Details
- Repo: `sage-prototypes`, served via `python3 -m http.server 8150`
- Quiz entry point: `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`
- Quiz is generated by `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` from `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html`
- Quiz styles: `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css` and `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`
- Quiz runs inside an iframe
- Reference site for link/button states: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`
- No inner scroll container allowed; page must use normal scroll; bottom "Before continuing" banner must not clip at 1280×720 or 1024×540
- States must be set once on the shared class, never per instance
- Playwright available in `node_modules` for browser verification
- Do not commit; leave no debug code; do not touch unrelated files

## Work State
### Completed
- Listed repo root and `ongoing_project/MTD` directory structure
- Read `skills/ROUTE.md` (routing table for the repo's skill system)

### Active
- No code changes made yet; agent was still in initial exploration/investigation phase

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Read `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css` and `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css` to understand current modal/scroll layout and existing link/button styles
2. Read `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html` and/or `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` to understand the quiz DOM structure, link classes, and button/option-card markup
3. Fetch the reference site's CSS to extract exact link-state and button-state values (colors, transitions, etc.)
4. Rewrite the quiz layout to remove the modal/inner-scroll container, making the quiz full-page with normal document scroll
5. Add the four link states (default, hover, focus-visible, active) on the shared link class per repo link guidelines
6. Add default/hover/pressed/focus states on the shared button and option-card classes
7. Verify with Playwright at 1280×720 and 1024×540 that no clipping occurs

## Relevant Files
- `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` – the quiz page to modify (generated output)
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html` – source template for the quiz
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css` – quiz styles
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css` – variant-specific quiz styles
- `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` – build script generating variants from source
- `skills/ROUTE.md` – repo routing/skill table (read for orientation)
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

6:    (Questions-styles__*, and the unique styled-components suffixes
7:    fGtfKe / kyStRA / hnTQsX / lScyZ / hSoqJU / eAvKFB / hePGzN / jroPAt /
8:    kwDpZY / gomnIV / hntNzi) — the bundle is minified and byte-frozen, so
9:    those tokens do not move. */

11: /* ── Fonts the page has but the quiz document does not ─────────────────── */
12: @font-face {
13:   font-family: "Sage Headline";
14:   src: url("https://fonts.sage.com/Sage_Headline-Black.woff2") format("woff2"),
15:        url("https://fonts.sage.com/Sage_Headline-Black.woff") format("woff");

17:   font-style: normal;
18:   font-display: swap;
19: }

21:   font-family: "Sage Text";
22:   src: url("https://fonts.sage.com/Sage_Text-Regular.woff2") format("woff2"),
23:        url("https://fonts.sage.com/Sage_Text-Regular.woff") format("woff");
24:   font-weight: 400;
25:   font-style: normal;
26:   font-display: swap;
27: }

31:        url("https://fonts.sage.com/Sage_Text-Medium.woff") format("woff");
32:   font-weight: 500;
33:   font-style: normal;
34:   font-display: swap;
35: }

37: /* ── Ground: pure black, no extra chrome ───────────────────────────────── */
38: html,
39: body {
40:   background: #000;
41: }
42: /* When the quiz is taller than a short viewport the frame itself scrolls
43:    (quiz-page.css clamps the iframe). Keep that scrollbar thin and quiet so it
44:    never crowds the dialog's X. */
45: html {
46:   scrollbar-width: thin;
47:   scrollbar-color: #5e5e5e transparent;

51:   height: 6px;

62:   height: auto;

67:    shorthand). Override the properties themselves so every element that reads
68:    them picks up the Figma type ramp without fighting per-element specificity. */

9:   var timer = 0;

15:       var height = Math.max(
16:         doc.documentElement.scrollHeight,
17:         doc.body ? doc.body.scrollHeight : 0,
18:         640
19:       );

23:           frame.style.height = next + "px";
24:         }

26:     } catch (error) {

28:     }
29:   }

## Objective
- Make the MTD quiz prototype full-screen (no modal, no inner scroll), apply the original site's link and button/option-card state styles (rest, hover, focus-visible, active/pressed) to shared classes only, keeping changes minimal.

## Important Details
- Repo: `sage-prototypes`, served via `python3 -m http.server 8150`
- Quiz entry point: `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` (generated output)
- Source template: `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html`
- Build script: `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` (one source → two outputs; asserts anchors; do not edit variant outputs by hand)
- Quiz iframe content lives in `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz/` (own `index.html`, `vendor/`, `assets/`)
- Iframe IDs: `#mtd-quiz-frame` (inline/Variant B), `#mtd-quiz-modal-frame` (Variant A modal)
- Key CSS: `quiz-page.css` (banner, section, frame, modal layout), `variant-quiz-figma.css` (fonts, Figma layout, progress bar, answer cards — injected into quiz iframe by `variant-quiz.js`)
- Key JS: `quiz-modal.js` (open/close, focus trap, Esc), `variant-quiz.js` (advance past entry card, inject CSS, fit iframe height, rewrite progress, swap icons, hide helper), `quiz-frame.js` (iframe height fitting via MutationObserver + ResizeObserver)
- Figma tokens in `variant-quiz-figma.css`: `Questions-styles__*`, `fGtfKe`, `kyStRA`, `hnTQsX`, `lScyZ`, `hSoqJU`, `eAvKFB`, `hePGzN`, `jroPAt`, `kwDpZY`, `gomnIV`, `hntNzi`
- `skills/shared/states.md` rule: "Write rest, hover, focus, and active before editing any of them. One state fixed alone leaves the same defect on the next state."
- Reference site for state values: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`
- No inner scroll container allowed; page must use normal document scroll
- Bottom "Before continuing" banner must not clip at 1280×720 or 1024×540
- States must be set once on the shared class, never per instance
- Playwright in `node_modules` for verification
- Do not commit; leave no debug code; do not touch unrelated files
- `verify.json` specs include taps: `.mtd-quiz-banner-cta` → `#mtd-quiz:target`, `.score-stripe a.button-checkout[href*="getstarted"]` → `#mtd-quiz-modal:not([hidden])`

## Work State
### Completed
- Listed repo root, `ongoing_project/MTD`, `mtd-income-tax/`, `variant-a/`, `mtd-income-tax/quiz/` directory structures
- Read `skills/ROUTE.md` and `skills/shared/states.md`
- Read `quiz-page.css` (banner, section, frame, modal layout including `position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9…`)
- Read `variant-quiz-figma.css` (font-faces, black ground, Figma layout tokens)
- Read `build-variants.js` (build logic, source→output relationship, anchor assertions)
- Read `variant-quiz.js` (advancement, CSS injection, height fitting, progress rewrite, icon swap, helper hide)
- Read `quiz-modal.js` (modal open/close, focus trap, Esc, focus return)
- Read `quiz-frame.js` (iframe height fitting, MutationObserver, ResizeObserver)
- Read both `verify.json` files (tap specs, expected selectors, viewport widths 1440/1000/390)

### Active
- No code changes made yet; agent has completed initial file reads and is ready to inspect the quiz iframe's internal DOM and the reference site's CSS

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Read `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz/index.html` and `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz/vendor/` to understand the quiz's internal DOM structure, link classes, button/option-card markup, and where shared state classes live
2. Fetch or inspect the reference site CSS (`https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`) to extract exact link-state and button-state values (colors, transitions, focus rings)
3. Identify the shared class names in the quiz bundle that need rest/hover/focus-visible/active state definitions
4. Rewrite the quiz layout (in source or `variant-quiz-figma.css`) to remove the modal/inner-scroll container, making the quiz full-page with normal document scroll
5. Add the four states (rest, hover, focus-visible, active) on the shared link class and shared button/option-card classes per `skills/shared/states.md`
6. Re-run `node ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` to regenerate variant outputs
7. Verify with Playwright at 1280×720 and 1024×540: no clipping, correct state transitions, no inner scroll

## Relevant Files
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz/index.html` – quiz iframe entry point; internal DOM structure to inspect
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz/vendor/` – minified quiz bundle; contains the classes that need state styles
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css` – injected into quiz iframe; where shared state classes and Figma layout live
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css` – outer page layout (banner, section, frame, modal); needs modal removal for full-screen
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz.js` – injects CSS, fits iframe, rewrites progress; may need trimming for full-screen mode
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-modal.js` – modal open/close logic; to be removed/disabled for full-screen
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-frame.js` – iframe height fitting; may be unnecessary if full-page
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html` – source template; edit here (not in variant outputs)
- `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` – regenerate variants after source changes
- `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` – generated output (do not edit by hand)
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/verify.json` – tap/verification specs
- `skills/shared/states.md` – rule: all four states must be written together
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

part.text:
## Objective
- Make the MTD quiz prototype full-screen (no modal, no inner scroll), apply the original site's link and button/option-card state styles (rest, hover, focus-visible, active/pressed) to shared classes only, keeping changes minimal.

## Important Details
- Repo: `sage-prototypes`, served via `python3 -m http.server 8150`
- Quiz entry point: `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` (generated output)
- Source template: `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html`
- Build script: `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` (one source → two outputs; asserts anchors; do not edit variant outputs by hand)
- Quiz iframe content: `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz/` — a **Figma Make / React app**, NOT server-rendered HTML
  - `quiz/index.html`: minimal shell with `<div id="root">`, loads `./assets/index-DhlXhpMI.js` (236 KB) + `./assets/index-NZKFqOaV.css` (40 KB); has sage-page-gate
  - `quiz/vendor/sage-solution-finder/`: `dependencies.js` (1.7 MB), `questions.js` (57 KB), `runtime.js` (2 KB)
  - `quiz/assets/index-DhlXhpMI.js`: minified React bundle (class search via `rg` returned nothing — classes are set via JS, not in HTML attributes)
  - `quiz/assets/index-NZKFqOaV.css`: minified CSS using **design tokens** (CSS custom properties) and **styled-components** mangled classes (`sc-kZOrUD`, etc.)
- Key stable tokens in quiz CSS: `solution-finder-host` (×14), `container` (×6), `mtd-result`, `mtd-screen`, `mtd-description`, `mtd-status-red/green/critical/amber`, `mtd-warning`
- Button state CSS variables in quiz CSS: `--global-modifier-button-hover`, `--global-modifier-button-hover-alt`, `--global-modifier-button-active`, `--global-modifier-button-active-alt`; color tokens like `--mode-color-action-main-hover`, `--mode-color-action-main-active`, `--mode-color-action-main-inverse-*`
- Figma tokens in `variant-quiz-figma.css`: `Questions-styles__*`, `fGtfKe`, `kyStRA`, `hnTQsX`, `lScyZ`, `hSoqJU`, `eAvKFB`, `hePGzN`, `jroPAt`, `kwDpZY`, `gomnIV`, `hntNzi`
- Iframe IDs: `#mtd-quiz-frame` (inline/Variant B), `#mtd-quiz-modal-frame` (Variant A modal)
- Key JS: `quiz-modal.js` (open/close, focus trap, Esc), `variant-quiz.js` (advance entry card, inject CSS, fit iframe, rewrite progress, swap icons, hide helper), `quiz-frame.js` (iframe height fitting via MutationObserver + ResizeObserver)
- Reference site: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html` — a **Next.js app** (uses `_next/static/chunks/`); fetched HTML shows "Get my recommendation" CTA and two solution cards (Sage Accounting, Sage Intacct)
- `skills/shared/states.md` rule: "Write rest, hover, focus, and active before editing any of them. One state fixed alone leaves the same defect on the next state."
- No inner scroll container allowed; page must use normal document scroll
- Bottom "Before continuing" banner must not clip at 1280×720 or 1024×540
- States must be set once on the shared class, never per instance
- Playwright in `node_modules` for verification
- Do not commit; leave no debug code; do not touch unrelated files
- `verify.json` specs include taps: `.mtd-quiz-banner-cta` → `#mtd-quiz:target`, `.score-stripe a.button-checkout[href*="getstarted"]` → `#mtd-quiz-modal:not([hidden])`
- Quiz CSS is minified; styled-components mangled suffixes are stable (byte-frozen bundle), so selectors in `variant-quiz-figma.css` target those suffixes, not semantic names

## Work State
### Completed
- Listed repo root, `ongoing_project/MTD`, `mtd-income-tax/`, `variant-a/`, `mtd-income-tax/quiz/` directory structures
- Read `skills/ROUTE.md` and `skills/shared/states.md`
- Read `quiz-page.css` (banner, section, frame, modal layout including `position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9…`)
- Read `variant-quiz-figma.css` (font-faces, black ground, Figma layout tokens)
- Read `build-variants.js` (build logic, source→output relationship, anchor assertions)
- Read `variant-quiz.js` (advancement, CSS injection, height fitting, progress rewrite, icon swap, helper hide)
- Read `quiz-modal.js` (modal open/close, focus trap, Esc, focus return)
- Read `quiz-frame.js` (iframe height fitting, MutationObserver, ResizeObserver)
- Read both `verify.json` files (tap specs, expected selectors, viewport widths 1440/1000/390)
- Read `quiz/index.html` — confirmed Figma Make React app with `<div id="root">`, sage-page-gate, asset paths
- Listed `quiz/assets/` and `quiz/vendor/sage-solution-finder/` contents and sizes
- Extracted CSS class tokens from minified `index-NZKFqOaV.css`: `solution-finder-host` (×14), button state modifiers (`button-hover`, `button-active`, etc.), design-token variables (`--global-modifier-button-*`, `--mode-color-action-main-*`)
- Fetched reference site HTML via `webfetch` and `curl` — confirmed Next.js app structure, identified CTA text "Get my recommendation" and two solution cards
- Read `mtd-income-tax/index.html` (source template) — confirmed quiz section structure, `quiz-page.css` link, mtd-hero Lottie

### Active
- Investigating exact state values (colors, transitions, focus rings) from the reference site's CSS for links and buttons
- Need to identify which shared classes in the quiz bundle receive the injected state styles
- Need to determine how to make quiz full-screen (remove modal wrapper, eliminate inner scroll) in `quiz-page.css` and `variant-quiz-figma.css`
- No code changes made yet

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Fetch the reference site's CSS (find `_next/static/css/` bundle URL from the HTML head) and extract exact rest/hover/focus-visible/active values (colors, box-shadows, transitions) for buttons and links
2. Determine the exact shared class names in the quiz CSS (`solution-finder-host`, button modifier classes) that will receive the four-state definitions
3. Rewrite `quiz-page.css` to remove the modal/inner-scroll container (`position: fixed; inset: 0` layout) so the quiz renders full-page with normal document scroll; update `variant-quiz.js` / `quiz-frame.js` accordingly
4. Add the four states (rest, hover, focus-visible, active) on the shared link class and shared button/option-card classes in `variant-quiz-figma.css` per `skills/shared/states.md`, using values from the reference site
5. Re-run `node ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` to regenerate variant outputs
6. Verify with Playwright at 1280×720 and 1024×540: no clipping, correct state transitions, no inner scroll

## Relevant Files
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz/index.html` — quiz iframe shell; Figma Make React app, `<div id="root">`; entry point only
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz/assets/index-NZKFqOaV.css` — minified quiz CSS; contains `solution-finder-host`, button state modifiers, design tokens; source of shared class names
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz/assets/index-DhlXhpMI.js` — minified React bundle (236 KB); renders DOM dynamically
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz/vendor/sage-solution-finder/dependencies.js` — 1.7 MB vendor deps (React, styled-components, etc.)
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz/vendor/sage-solution-finder/questions.js` — 57 KB quiz question data
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css` — injected into quiz iframe by `variant-quiz.js`; where shared state classes and Figma layout live; **primary edit target for state styles**
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css` — outer page layout (banner, section, frame, modal); **needs modal/inner-scroll removal for full-screen**
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz.js` — injects CSS, fits iframe, rewrites progress; may need trimming for full-screen mode
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-modal.js` — modal open/close logic; to be removed/disabled for full-screen
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-frame.js` — iframe height fitting; may be unnecessary if full-page
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html` — source template; **edit here** (not in variant outputs)
- `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` — regenerate variants after source changes
- `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` — generated output (do not edit by hand)
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/verify.json` — tap/verification specs
- `skills/shared/states.md` — rule: all four states must be written together
- Reference site: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html` — Next.js app; source of truth for state color/transition values
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

# Route

This file is the process. It is the same in every project and on every machine. The job table is `skills/ROUTE.md` in the repo you are in. That table is the only project-specific part.

Search the table. Do not read it end to end. Take one row.

1. A cell that starts with `node ` is the command. Run it. Open nothing else.
2. A cell that says `none` is a Make. Open the one file that row names.
3. Two When cells still match. Stop and ask. Do not open both.

A task the table does not name is still this process. In the same commit, add one row: when it applies, which file to open, which files to leave closed. A second task that hits the same row replaces the sentence that failed, or adds one trap sentence when that row has none for this miss. The same trap on two rows moves into `skills/shared/<name>.md`, and the rows keep that name. A trap is the command or the refusal. It does not cite an archive.

A better way replaces the old one in the same edit. Delete the sentence, the step, or the row it retires. Add with nothing deleted only when the table had no row. The route changes when When, Open, or Leave closed changed. The how-to changes in the one file that row already opens, and it is not copied into a second skill or an archive. A trap that was already written, and the miss still shipped, is replaced by the check. It is not given another sentence. One miss replaces one instruction. A rejected method is one line, or it is gone. The attempt stays in git.

A script becomes a command cell only when it imports the parts it reuses. A script that draws those parts stays `none`.

A run that followed a `node` cell and matched edits neither the table nor an archive.

Paths are relative to the repo root. Nothing in this process uses a home directory, a machine name, or a secret. A commit of `skills/route/`, `skills/ROUTE.md`, `skills/shared/`, and `tooling/check-route.js` is the copy the next laptop, desktop, or VM gets with `git pull`.

## Another project

Copy `skills/route/` and `tooling/check-route.js`. Copy `skills/route/TEMPLATE.md` to `skills/ROUTE.md` and fill the rows for that project. Add a file under `skills/shared/` only when a row names it. Generate `tooling/route-grandfather.json` from the folders that already exist, then wire `node tooling/check-route.js` into that project's check. Do not copy another project's component table.

Product UI as HTML into a file path: measure the host ancestors' boxes before editing; a wrapper with `overflow:hidden` clips below content, and element screenshots never catch it.

Product UI as HTML from a node inside a component set: `figma-shot.js` cannot export there (the transport append is rejected) — measure live `get_design_context` geometry instead of the SVG pattern.

Product UI as HTML for a tab pane's picture: a raster pane inside a PNGs-only pattern takes live HTML only as a recorded deviation (the hero media-slot precedent — no SVG either way), and its 2x measure comes from `download_assets --defaultScale 2`; `get_screenshot` answers 1x for that vector node whatever `maxDimension` says, so sizing off it reads every small role a size short. A mounted art is only "as created" if the pane gives it the width it was drawn at — the kit's 58.33% media slot (568 of a 994 pane) ran the tax summary on its three-column rung while its card shows five, so the pane sizes the art to ONE box (max 640, min 360, 500 tall) and the copy takes the remainder at a measured floor (292: at 290 the body cuts "built-in"); a 500-tall frame is not a 500-tall picture — the guide's own air inside it leaves the art at 417/460 and three tabs read smaller than the other two, so the air is zeroed and the art drawn at the box; and a box narrower than an art's mount air (Cleanup's 612 + 24/24 = 660.1) fires that art's rung and lets the dialog cover a radio, so that one pane keeps its column and draws a 640 stage inside it.

Product UI as HTML whose SVG 403s: the shipped `@2x` raster is then the measure source, and its edges are a downscale blend — size type off the measured cap height, never an assumed em ratio (0.72 read the whole small-text ramp a size small), and report the interior agreement rather than chasing its outermost 1px.

Product UI as HTML from a supplied screenshot: the bitmap's black or grey matte is capture surface, not product UI — take the art bounds from the window edges, derive the floor from the narrowest label's ink run and its browser width at 1px (a 2× cap-height read includes descenders and sizes the whole ramp too large), and put the page's backdrop behind the windows rather than repainting the matte. At the smallest rung the rows must feed ONE grid (a per-row `max-content` label track steps every value sideways), the divider belongs to the fieldset's right edge rather than the window's, and the 360 floor's body air leaves at ≤375 — otherwise the scroller engages at 360 itself. A two-window picture keeps both windows as two overlaid surfaces at a phone width — the front right-flush over the back, both front edges right of the back's, never one flow column or one merged surface — and the back window keeps its source width ratio and its FULL body — only its WIDTH scales with the art: its copy, its controls and its body length keep the source's own size at every width, the same absolute type the dialog is frozen at, so its header drops its " - Select Record Type" suffix (a declared rung at a 440px stage, where the full string needs 423) instead of wrapping or shrinking, and the dialog's top edge sits at one fixed offset because nothing above it moves (a scaled glyph put the radios on 6.99px; freezing the type while the box shrinks makes a wide title strip with a giant title, not the same window; shrinking the type to the floor makes a 10px title under a 15.49px one; scaling the HEIGHT makes a shorter window, and the scale here is the horizontal space only); hiding its radios is the wrong rung. A balance row keeps the source's shape — label on the left, both numbers beside it on the `Balance:` line — because putting the label above its numbers wraps a value the source never wraps.

A product-UI variant of a shipped art (a second composition, a 10px floor, a scale) is the frame's arithmetic, and a screenshot cannot show it: run `node tooling/floor-check.js` — canvas 500, smallest type, one card gutter, the table's seat on its footer, the chart's clearance, the composition, at 29 widths in both switch states. A chart whose height is paid twice breaks the frame first: the 1.2× pie that fitted one aged card was a 508 canvas once the two were stacked, and a 137 donut was a 533 canvas at every width past 730 while every gate the page had still passed (2026-10-17).

Product UI as HTML, ruled cuts: scope cuts by media × container (`@media (max-width: 1079px) { @container (max-width: 559px) { … } }`) — a slot-width-only cut list fires on 1180–1420 laptop slots and hides card titles on desktops; pin the ruled height in the media block, never inside the pane's own `@container` (dead CSS — computed `0px` everywhere), and gate `scrollWidth == clientWidth` at phone widths (an art with a nowrap title needs `container-type: inline-size` to follow its slot; `min-width: 0` does not lower an intrinsic contribution).

Product UI as an animation: a piece that already exists as component HTML/CSS fills no raster slots — copy it verbatim and carry the page bundle's faces, line-height and box-sizing, or the art renders 7.4px short with fallback glyphs.

Page chrome: the same symptom on two pages, or a bug only on the deployed page, is not a folder edit. Run `node tooling/audit-live-comments.js` first. A missing column is a migration — sweep it per `docs/SUPABASE-APPLY.md`, and a re-run of one must be a no-op: a `create policy` without its own `drop policy if exists` aborts the whole Studio batch (42710) — `20261014130000` carried one until 2026-10-16. Paste-success is the editor's opinion; the deployed page's console going quiet is the after-apply proof, and it is scripted now: `node tooling/verify-live-doors.js`, `node tooling/verify-live-responsive.js`, `node tooling/verify-live-cpp-paths.js`, plus the write path's `node tooling/verify-write-roundtrip.js` (refused → stamped → resolved → deleted, nothing left behind). A live gate aimed at the page the change did not touch is not evidence about the page that shipped: `verify-live-responsive.js` opened only the unchanged vendor page and passed 12/12 while customer-payment-services scrolled sideways at 390px — it walks both CPP pages now, and a gated page hides its panes, so `render-check.js` strips the lock the way `check-tab-email.js` does. A migration cannot enable a dashboard hook: applying `15120000`'s function changes nothing until Authentication → Hooks → Before user created points at it — enable it (2026-10-16) and prove it with a real non-Sage sign-up, which must return `403` before any account exists (`node tooling/verify-signup-hook.js`). `node tooling/verify-page-comments.js` never loads `main.css`. A brand mark is already exported. Copy `icons/logos/sage.svg` onto the global bar and `icons/product-identifiers/sage-intacct--dark.svg` onto the dark sticky bar. Do not redraw either file.

The gate's viewing passcode and bot id are rows in `quick_signin_accounts`, never code: `resolve_pair()` is the one oracle the gate, `middleware.js` and the panel share, and the panel's Access section is the editor. A code changed in one place drifts the others. A tool the docs name is not evidence it runs: `add-pair.js` still rewrote a source array two weeks after the pairs moved into `quick_signin_accounts` (fixed 2026-10-16); it needs the service key and is the only thing that also moves the bot's auth password. A tool that measures the deployed page needs both doors: `audit-live-comments.js` carries the passcode cookie and a @sage.com stub session — without them it measures the sign-in shell and times out, which is exactly what the server door (2026-10-15) did to it for a day. A sweep must not reset a pair: the seeds insert only when the row is absent and self-test against the code the row holds — `do update set code` drove a rotated code back to the committed default on every re-run (fixed 2026-10-16).

A deployed old-tree folder URL 404s while its no-slash sibling redirects: trailing-slash normalisation runs before the redirect rules, so `:path*` never matches a URL that ends in a slash. The fix is the explicit rule pair plus the `middleware.js` backstop, not a wider wildcard. A case mismatch between macOS and Linux (e.g. Ongoing_project vs ongoing_project from .gitignore) 404s all child pages on Vercel: keep .gitignore rules lowercase and resolve casing dynamically in `middleware.js`.

/**
 * check-interaction-contract.js — every button of the same class must have
 * EXACTLY the same hover, focus-visible and active look.
 *
 * PART 1 (static): no button state rule (:hover/:focus/:focus-visible/:active)
 * may live anywhere except the shared vendor stylesheets (CANONICAL_CSS), and
 * no page may use an alias button class that carries its own state rule.
 *
 * PART 2 (dynamic, headless Chromium): render every PAGES entry, measure the
 * hover / focus-visible / active computed-style signature of every button in
 * GROUPS/ALIASES and fail if a group has more than one distinct look per state.
 *
 * Exit 0 only if everything passes; 1 on any violation (each printed as a
 * line starting with `FAIL:`). Final line on pass: `OK: ...`.
 *
 * Also usable as a library: module.exports = { checkInteractionContract }
 * where checkInteractionContract is async and returns { ok, failures }.

A mounted art is only "as created" if the pane gives it the width it was drawn at — the kit's 58.33% media slot (568 of a 994 pane) ran the tax summary on its three-column rung while its card shows five, so the pane sizes the art to ONE box (max 640, min 360, 500 tall) and the copy takes the remainder at a measured floor (292: at 290 the body cuts "built-in"); a 500-tall frame is not a 500-tall picture — the guide's own air inside it leaves the art at 417/460 and three tabs read smaller than the other two, so the air is zeroed and the art drawn at the box; and a box narrower than an art's mount air (Cleanup's 612 + 24/24 = 660.1) fires that art's rung and lets the dialog cover a radio, so that one pane keeps its column and draws a 640 stage inside it.

Product UI as HTML whose SVG 403s: the shipped `@2x` raster is then the measure source, and its edges are a downscale blend — size type off the measured cap height, never an assumed em ratio (0.72 read the whole small-text ramp a size small), and report the interior agreement rather than chasing its outermost 1px.

Product UI as HTML from a supplied screenshot: the bitmap's black or grey matte is capture surface, not product UI — take the art bounds from the window edges, derive the floor from the narrowest label's ink run and its browser width at 1px (a 2× cap-height read includes descenders and sizes the whole ramp too large), and put the page's backdrop behind the windows rather than repainting the matte. At the smallest rung the rows must feed ONE grid (a per-row `max-content` label track steps every value sideways), the divider belongs to the fieldset's right edge rather than the window's, and the 360 floor's body air leaves at ≤375 — otherwise the scroller engages at 360 itself. A two-window picture keeps both windows as two overlaid surfaces at a phone width — the front right-flush over the back, both front edges right of the back's, never one flow column or one merged surface — and the back window keeps its source width ratio and its FULL body — only its WIDTH scales with the art: its copy, its controls and its body length keep the source's own size at every width, the same absolute type the dialog is frozen at, so its header drops its " - Select Record Type" suffix (a declared rung at a 440px stage, where the full string needs 423) instead of wrapping or shrinking, and the dialog's top edge sits at one fixed offset because nothing above it moves (a scaled glyph put the radios on 6.99px; freezing the type while the box shrinks makes a wide title strip with a giant title, not the same window; shrinking the type to the floor makes a 10px title under a 15.49px one; scaling the HEIGHT makes a shorter window, and the scale here is the horizontal space only); hiding its radios is the wrong rung. A balance row keeps the source's shape — label on the left, both numbers beside it on the `Balance:` line — because putting the label above its numbers wraps a value the source never wraps.

A product-UI variant of a shipped art (a second composition, a 10px floor, a scale) is the frame's arithmetic, and a screenshot cannot show it: run `node tooling/floor-check.js` — canvas 500, smallest type, one card gutter, the table's seat on its footer, the chart's clearance, the composition, at 29 widths in both switch states. Product UI as an animation: a piece that already exists as component HTML/CSS fills no raster slots — copy it verbatim and carry the page bundle's faces, line-height and box-sizing, or the art renders 7.4px short with fallback glyphs.

Page chrome: the same symptom on two pages, or a bug only on the deployed page, is not a folder edit. Run `node tooling/audit-live-comments.js` first.
